Structures-Survival Engineer said about it: I take from the Turbine Design Report - 2024 Collegiate Wind Competition - California Polytechnic State University, San Luis Obispo (E19) that nacelle plates and mounts are made from 6061 aluminum, which I use for the bedplate; the side-view layout with rotor clearance and post interface (E28) shows rotor plus nacelle inside the cube with only the post below outside, and the tilt plus overhang clearance concept (C9) keeps the 2.50 cm per-side gap positive under the 0.516 mm deflection (E26).
